title: Citizen Science: You're Part of the Map
assessmentMethod: Private reflective journal entry, not scored

body.en: Every module you complete on BIPI adds one more anonymous data point to a live, national picture of what Ghana understands about climate change — and where knowledge gaps still put people at risk. Think about your own community: what's one climate change or weather pattern you've noticed shifting over the last few years, that you don't think enough people around you know about yet?
